book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Yeesu araanga ameegyo ga Abhafarisayo
Ambe, Abhafarisayo abharebhe na abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa bhakarweera Yerusaremu bhakaaza ku Yeesu, bhakamubhuurya,
“Kwaki abhaanabheega bhaazo bharasarya eziisiira zino bhazaazi bheetu bhakatutigira? Bhayo bhararya ebhyaakurya, nawe bhatakwiisaabha amabhoko gaabhu kyeego ekweenderwa!”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Kwaki na neemwe murasarya obhuswaagyo bhwa Taatabhugya kwo okutuniirira eziisiira zyeenyu?
Taatabhugya abhugiri, ‘Obhasuuke wuuso na nyoko weenyu.’
Kweeki abhugiri, ‘Wowoosi wuno akumutuka wiise kasi nyoko waabhu, areenderwa yiitwe.’
Nawe emwe murabhuga kubha, omuutu ariikiriribhwa kumubhuurira wiise kasi nina waabhu, ‘Ebhigiro bhino niari ndanagya okukusakirya, nimariri okubhiruusya ku Taatabhugya.’
Kweego mureegya kubha, omuutu atakweenderwa kumusuuka wiise kasi nina waabhu. Nawe kuyo nikwe okuzeera engʼana ya Taatabhugya kwo okutuniirira eziisiira zyeenyu.
Emwe abhabheehi! Taatabhugya akagaamba obhuheene iguru weenyu okuhitira omurooti waaye Isaya,

content.text: nawe eziikoro zyaabhu ziri kure neenye.
kwo okubha bhareegya obhuswaagyo bhwa abhaatu

content: Amangʼana gano gakumukira omuutu
Ambe, Yeesu akabhirikira esaango ya abhaatu, akabhabhuurira,
“Muniitegeerere bhuzomu, na mumenye amangʼana gano nikubhabhuurira! Bhitari bhigiro bhino bhikusikira mumunwa nibhyo bhikumukira omuutu. Nawe, amangʼana gano gakurwa mumunwa, nigo gakumukira omuutu.”
Niho abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhakagya kweewe, bhakamubhuurya, “Omenyiri kubha Abhafarisayo hano bhakiigwa amangʼana gaazo, bhakabhiihirirwa bhukongʼu?”
Yeesu akabhakyoora, “Ebhituutu bhyobhyoosi bhino Taata waane wa mwiisaaro ataabhyeemirye, arabhiiha.
Mubhatige bhayo! Ebho ni kya abhakaangati abhahoku bhano bhakukaangata abhahoku. Eraabhe omuhoku arakaangata omuhoku omurikyaaye, bhoosi bhabhiri bharatubhira mwiiruuma.”
Ambe, Petero akamubhuurira Yeesu, “Tugarurire ekireengyo kiyo.”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Naabhe emwe mutana amangʼeeni go okumenya ekireengyo kirya?
Mutamenyiri kubha kyokyoosi kino kikusikira mumunwa, kihaasikira muunda yo omuutu, kyaamwe kihaareka mumubhiri gwaaye?
Nawe kyokyoosi kino kikureka mumunwa gwo omuutu, kirarwa mukoro yaaye. Kiyo nikyo kikugirya omuutu kubha makire.
Mukoro yo omuutu, nimwe muyo gakurwa amiiseego mabhiihu, obhwiiti, obhuseebheeti, obhutuungiri, obhwiibhi, obhumenyeekererya bhwo orurimi na amatuki.
Goosi gayo, nigo gano gakumukora omuutu kubha makire. Nawe omuutu atakunagya kubha makire kwe ekigirirye kyo okurya ebhyaakurya akyaari okwiisaabha amabhoko kyeego ekweenderwa.”
Obhwiikirirya bhukuru bhwo omukari wumwe wuno atari Omuyahudi
Ambe, Yeesu akatanura hayo, akagya haguhi ne emigye gya Tiro na Sidooni.
Niho akasikana no omukari wumwe, yaari ni Mukanaani we eyo. Akaaza ku Yeesu, akabhirikira kwe eriiraka, “Ee Omukuru, Omwaana wo omutemi Daudi,
onirorere ebhigoongi! Muukya waane atiirirwe bhukongʼu ne eriisaambwa eriibhi.”
Nawe Yeesu ataamukyooriri engʼana yoyoosi. Kyaamwe, abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakaaza no okumusabha, “Omubhuurire omukari wuno agye, kwo okubha aratema ekituri eno aratutuniirira inyuma.”
Akabhakyoora, “Taatabhugya yaanitumiri kwiiguru ya Abhiiziraeri ego, bhari kye eziingʼoondu zino zibhuriri.”
Omukari wuyo akamwiisukira Yeesu, akiihigama embere waaye, akamusabha, “Ee Omukuru, onisakirye!”
Akamukyoora, “Etari bhuzomu kugega ebhyaakurya bhya abhaana no okuzirekerera eziimbwa.”
Omukari wuyo akabhuga, “Niigo eri Omukuru, nawe naabhe eziimbwa nazyo zirarya amasaagyo gano gakutoondobhoka haasi okurwa kwiigari rya abhakuru bhaabhu.”
Yeesu akamukyoora, “Ee omukari, obhwiikirirya bhwaazo ni bhukuru! Taatabhugya akukorere kyeego okweenda.” Hayohayo, omuukya waaye akahora.
Yeesu arahorya abharweeri bhaaru
Yeesu akatanura hayo, akagya kuhitira embarika ye Enyaanza ya Gariraaya. Akatiira mukiguru no okwiikara eyo.

Abhaatu bhaaru bhukongʼu bhakagya ku Yeesu, bhakamureetera amagata, abhahoku, abharema, amamuumu na abharweeri abhaandi bhaaru. Abhaatu bhayo bhakatuura abharweeri bhayo haguhi na amaguru ga Yeesu, neewe akabhahorya.
Abhaatu bhakaruguura bhukongʼu hano bhaaruuzi amamuumu garakeerenia, abharema bhahoriri, amagata garageenda na abhahoku bhararora. Bhakataanga okumukumya Taatabhugya wa Abhiiziraeri.
Yeesu arariisya abhaatu kukira ebhikwe bhine

Niho Yeesu akabhabhirikira abhaanabheega bhaaye, akabhabhuurira, “Ndabharorera ebhigoongi abhaatu bhano, twiikeeri nabho eziisiku isatu na bhoono bhatana ebhyaakurya bhyobhyoosi. Nitakweenda nibharage bhagye bhane enzara, kwo okubha abhaandi bharatura kuseezeka munzira.”
Abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakamubhuurya, “Mbe, turi mwiitirigo hano, na abhaatu ni bhaaru. Turatura kubhona hayi ebhyaakurya bhyo okwiisa okubhiigutya abhaatu bhano bhoosi?”
Yeesu akabhabhuurya, “Mune emikaate eriinge?” Bhakamukyoora, “Tune emikaate muhuungati ne eziiswe suuhwiigo.”
Ambe, Yeesu akaswaagya abhaatu bhoosi bhiikare haasi.
Akagega emikaate muhuungati girya ne eziiswe zirya, akamubhuurira Taatabhugya, “Ozomirye.” Kyaamwe, akabhega, akabhaha abhaanabheega bhaaye, nabho abhaanabheega bhakabhatwaanira abhaatu.
Abhaatu bhoosi bhakarya, bhakiiguta. Kyaamwe, abhaanabheega bhakakumania amasaagyo, bhakiizurya ebhisehi muhuungati.
Abhaatu bhano bhaariiri ebhyaakurya bhirya bhaari bhasubhe bhikwe bhine (4,000), abhakari na abhaana bhataabharirwe.
Ambe, Yeesu akabharaga abhaatu bharya, akatiira mubhwaato, akagya orubhaara rwa Magadaani.

footnotes.text: Bhatakwiisaabha amabhoko gaabhu kyeego ekweenderwa, eramenyeekererya obhwiisaabhi bhuno bhwaari esiira ye Ekiyahudi kwiiguru yo okwiiyeerya amabhoko.
a Rora Okurwa 20:12; Obhuhiiti bhwe Emigiro 5:16.

Abhayahudi bhaari bhariisiga kubha Masiya akarwa mukisyooko kyo omutemi Daudi, wuno akuhorya amarweeri gaabhu. Rora Zaburi 89:3-37; Yeremia 23:5-6; Ezekieri 34:23-24. Rora Omwaana wa Daudi mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Kugega ebhyaakurya bhya abhaana no okuzirekerera eziimbwa, obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubha Abhayahudi bhabhone obhusakiribhwa hiinga bhakyaari okubhona abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi.
